Initial release of iflytek-ocr-invoice.

- Provides invoice and receipt OCR using iFlytek (科大讯飞) API.
- Supports VAT invoices, taxi receipts, train tickets, toll and medical bills, bank receipts, and more.
- Extracts structured data from images (png, jpg, bmp, gif, tif, pdf).
- Includes a command-line Python 3 script for usage and error handling.
- Detailed troubleshooting and error code guide included for common problems.
